p: unto us: Because God promised to deliver them, not for their sakes, but for his Name, Isa 48:11, therefore they ground their prayer on this promise.
Where is now their God: When the wicked see that God does not always accomplish his promise as they imagined, they think there is no God.
pleased: No impediments can slow his work, but he uses even the impediments to serve his will.
silver and gold: Seeing that neither the matter nor the form can commend their idols it follows that there is no reason that they should be esteemed.
hands: He shows what great vanity it is to ask help from them who not only have no help in them, but lack sense and reason.
like unto them: As much without sense as blocks and stones.
O house of Aaron: For they were appointed by God as instructors and teachers of faith and religion for others to follow.
will bless the house of Israel: That is, he will continue his graces toward his people.
made heaven and earth: And therefore still governs and continues all things in it.
heaven: And they declare enough his sufficiency so that the world serves him nothing, but to show his fatherly care toward men.
go down into silence: Though the dead set forth God's glory, yet he means here, that they praise him not in his Church and congregation.
